import os
os.makedirs("crucible_hidden", exist_ok=True)

# Write test_m1.py
test_m1 = '''"""Tests for milestone m1: Handle tz-aware datetimes in naturalday."""

import datetime as dt
from unittest import mock


def test_naturalday_tz_aware_returns_local_date():
    """When system UTC date is Oct 15, a tz-aware datetime whose local date is Oct 16 (AEDT +11)
    should return 'Oct 16', not 'Oct 15'."""
    import humanize.time

    # System UTC date is Oct 15, so AEDT (+11) local date is Oct 16
    utc_oct15 = dt.datetime(2023, 10, 15, 13, 0, tzinfo=dt.timezone.utc)
    tz = dt.timezone(dt.timedelta(hours=11))
    value = dt.datetime(2023, 10, 16, 1, 0, tzinfo=tz)

    with mock.patch.object(humanize.time.dt, "datetime") as mock_dt:
        mock_dt.today.return_value = utc_oct15.date()
        mock_dt.datetime.now.return_value = utc_oct15
        result = humanize.time.naturalday(value)
        assert result == "Oct 16"


def test_naturalday_naive_datetime_unchanged():
    """Naive datetimes should keep existing behavior (compare against system date.today())."""
    import humanize.time

    target = dt.datetime(2023, 10, 16, 12, 0)  # naive
    with mock.patch.object(humanize.time.dt, "datetime") as mock_dt_cls:
        mock_dt_cls.today.return_value = dt.date(2023, 10, 16)
        result = humanize.time.naturalday(target)
        assert result == "today"


def test_naturalday_plain_date_unchanged():
    """Plain date objects should keep existing behavior."""
    import humanize.time

    target = dt.date(2023, 10, 16)
    with mock.patch.object(humanize.time.dt, "datetime") as mock_dt_cls:
        mock_dt_cls.today.return_value = dt.date(2023, 10, 16)
        result = humanize.time.naturalday(target)
        assert result == "today"


def test_naturalday_yesterday_with_tz():
    """A tz-aware datetime that is yesterday in its own timezone should return 'yesterday'."""
    import humanize.time

    # System UTC is Oct 16 02:00 => AEDT (+11) is Oct 16 13:00
    # So Oct 15 13:00 AEDT is yesterday
    utc_now = dt.datetime(2023, 10, 16, 2, 0, tzinfo=dt.timezone.utc)
    tz = dt.timezone(dt.timedelta(hours=11))
    value = dt.datetime(2023, 10, 15, 13, 0, tzinfo=tz)

    with mock.patch.object(humanize.time.dt, "datetime") as mock_dt_cls:
        mock_dt_cls.today.return_value = utc_now.date()
        mock_dt_cls.datetime.now.return_value = utc_now
        result = humanize.time.naturalday(value)
        assert result == "yesterday"
'''

with open("crucible_hidden/test_m1.py", "w") as f:
    f.write(test_m1)

print("test_m1.py written")
